entities.summary: Lumina Desktop Environment, or simply Lumina, is a plugin-based desktop environment for Unix and Unix-like operating systems. It was designed specifically as a system interface for the now-discontinued TrueOS as well as systems derived from Berkeley Software Distribution (BSD) in general, but it has been ported to various Linux distributions.
